definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese martial arts that emphasize both physical technique and spiritual/moral development, including judo, kendo, karate, and aikido.

examples.japanese: {武道|ぶどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}じて⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
examples.english: I train my spirit through martial arts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{武道|ぶどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese martial arts are popular around the world.

examples.japanese: {武道|ぶどう}{館|かん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A kendo tournament was held at the martial arts hall.

notes:
{武道|ぶどう} refers to Japanese martial arts as a discipline — emphasizing spiritual and moral development alongside physical technique.

TYPES OF {武道|ぶどう}:
- ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧: judo
- ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧: kendo (sword fighting)
- ⟦{空手|からて}→空手：04454_karate⟧: karate
- ⟦{合気道|あいきどう}→合気道：17630_aikidou⟧: aikido
- ⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧: kyudo (archery)
- ⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧: sumo

COMPOUNDS:
- {武道|ぶどう}{館|かん}: martial arts hall
- {武道|ぶどう}{家|か}: martial artist
- {武道|ぶどう}⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: martial arts spirit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {武道|ぶどう}: martial arts as a way of life (⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ = "the way")
- ⟦{武術|ぶじゅつ}→武術：13244_bujutsu⟧: martial arts as combat technique
- ⟦{格闘技|かくとうぎ}→格闘技：09246_kakutougi⟧: fighting sports (broader, includes non-Japanese arts)
